title: Hospital Staff Left Stunned After Tyrant’s Unhinged Outburst
description:
On May 26th, 2024  Hospital staff called 911 after an unhinged woman came inside the hospital and started causing absolute chaos. When officers arrived and asked her to leave, she refused and continued to act in an irrational manner.
